fields.statement: QA at e8f4c34c, hands-on. (1) go test ./internal/api -run 'TestReadBudget$|TestTimeWithinBudget' -count=1 -v with RHIZA_BUDGET_LOG set: both PASS; the log has one 'attempt 1/3' line per read, medians 1.5-6.7 ms under the 50 ms budget. (2) Budget lowered to 4 ms in a throwaway edit (reverted): roadmap and ready in both views were timed 3 times each, every attempt logged as 'attempt 1/3'..'3/3' to the budget log, and the test failed with 'median over 4ms on every attempt'; reads under budget stopped after attempt 1. (3) Real 50 ms budget with 22 'yes' CPU hogs running outside the test: PASS, medians up to 16 ms. The over-then-under path was not hit with real timings at a borderline budget; TestTimeWithinBudget covers it with an injected timer and asserts readBudget == 50ms. make check with the run env unset exited 0.
